label: evidence score
instructions: How well does the {side} back its claims with reasons, examples or facts?
levels: Bare assertions: no reasons, examples or facts.
A few reasons, mostly general or loosely tied to the claims.
Most main claims have a reason or example, some vague or off the point.
Nearly every main claim backed by a relevant reason or example; one or two thin.
Every main claim backed by a specific, relevant reason or example.
